import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartVMonotone

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace ProbeP4R6b

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

/-- A retraction of the open inclusion forces V = TOP, purely topologically:
V.i has a left inverse, so V.i.base is surjective, so V = top. -/
theorem probeTop {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Opens)
    (r : X ⟶ (V : Scheme.{u})) (hr : V.ι ≫ r = 𝟙 _) : True := by
  -- what does r give at the level of points?
  have h1 : ∀ x : X, ((V.ι).base (r.base x) : X) = x := by
    sorry
  trivial

end ProbeP4R6b

end AlgebraicGeometry
